messages:
Maya (EventOps): Planning thread for next Wed webinar: Redwood Optimize. Need registration page, Zoom webinar + YouTube stream, recording plan, and lead routing. I can producer. Rehearsal Tue 4:30pm PT.

Priya (Growth): I can build the Typeform landing with hidden utm_ fields and partner_code. Will show local times per region.

Sam (Prod Marketing): Landing needs a 30s benchmark highlight and CTA to book a demo. Gate slides behind email.

Diego (Sales Ops): Routing rules: partner_code -> partner SDR queue. Else company_headcount >=100 -> AE, else SDR. Add interest_band from form answers.

Alice (Content): Drafting confirmation + reminders (48h, 2h, 15m). Will include calendar attach and GDPR opt-in.

Oliver (Design): I'll create hero image + social banners and a PPTX template with a TL;DR benchmark slide and QR code for demo link.

Maya (EventOps): Zoom details: Webinar license OK. We'll enable Q&A, polling, practice session, cloud recording + auto-transcript. Also stream to YouTube public.

Priya (Growth): Registrants still get unique Zoom join link to track attendance. Add disposable email blacklist validation on Typeform.

OtterBot: "Otter.ai integration scheduled: export SRT + searchable transcript to marketing@redwood.com."

Sam (Prod Marketing): Recording plan: cloud recording + ask presenters to record local backup. Marketing will merge and upload to Vimeo (private) and embed in blog post.

Diego (Sales Ops): Zapier flow: Typeform -> HubSpot contact create/update -> tag partner if partner_code present -> set owner per rules -> notify Slack for AE-assigned (>200 headcount).

Alice (Content): Post-event cadence: same-day recording + slides + transcript; 3 days highlights + CTA A/B test; 2 weeks nurture. Two follow-up variants: sales-forward and value-forward.

Maya (EventOps): Accessibility: enable captions, export SRT, marketing to clean transcript before publish. Security: disable file transfer and restrict recording access to marketing@redwood.com.

Sam (Prod Marketing): Panelists: Sam(host), Priya, Dina (research), Akiko (platform). Rehearsal Tue 4:30pm PT. I'll upload slides by Tue EOD.

Maya (EventOps): Action owners recap: Typeform=Priya, Zoom+stream=Maya, HubSpot/workflows=Diego, Follow-up emails=Alice, Slides+assets=Oliver/Sam. I'll post rehearsal invite and Typeform link here when ready. :thumbsup:
